units.text: INT. FISHING BOAT - CABIN - NIGHT
A small cabin that smells of diesel and wet wool.
A radio phone crackles on its hook beside a chart pinned flat with two mugs.
The boat rolls; the mugs do not move.
Kim sits at the table, perfectly upright, hands around nothing.
Kip stands at the door, a duffel bag at his feet, and does not take off his coat.

You've come all this way in weather like this to stand in a doorway. I should be flattered. Our father would have said: Kip, a man who won't sit has already decided to leave. And you did decide, didn't you? Somewhere on the road, between the third petrol station and the one where you bought the sandwiches you haven't eaten. I could see it in how you tied the rope.
units.name: KIM

units.text: I'm sitting.
units.name: KIP

units.text: He does not sit.
The radio phone RINGS.
Neither of them moves.
It rings four times, five.
That will be for you.
units.name: KIM

units.text: How would you know?
units.name: KIP

units.text: Nobody has called this boat in two years.
units.name: KIM

units.text: Kip crosses and lifts the receiver.
He listens.
His jaw works.
Kip. Mr. Brandt wants to know if it's done. We have the other half of the money waiting. He says tonight, or not at all.
units.name: A MAN'S VOICE

units.text: Kip lowers the receiver slowly to his chest.
Kim has not moved.
Kim is looking at the chart, tracing a finger along a coastline that no longer exists.
It's a lovely story, you know. Two brothers on a boat. One of them has to be the wave, and one of them the rock. I have always been the rock. It is very quiet being the rock.
units.name: KIM

units.text: Tell him tomorrow.
units.name: KIP

units.text: He said tonight.
units.name: A MAN'S VOICE

units.text: Kip hangs up the phone.
He picks up the duffel and, with great care, sets it on the table between them.
He unzips it a few inches and then, just as carefully, zips it shut again.
This is the last time they will sit at this table.
Put the kettle on, Kip. Whatever is in the bag will keep till it boils.
units.name: KIM
